profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | AWS, Cloud-Native Systems, Distributed Applications | Building Secure & Scalable Platforms
profile.summary:
I’m a Senior Software Engineer specializing in backend microservices and distributed systems, with a strong focus on building scalable, reliable, and secure platforms. I enjoy designing solutions that address complex technical challenges and deliver measurable impact.

My experience includes working with cloud-native architectures, applying engineering best practices, and collaborating in Agile environments to deliver production-grade systems. I’m particularly interested in work that improves system reliability, security, and efficiency at scale.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer, using Kotlin, Spring, SpringBoot, Kafka, Confluent, SQL database for a distributed microservices streaming platform in the company WorldLink US, working for a client within the travel sector.

• Design and take architectural decision
• Analysis and development of new features in the backend layer
• Deployment of new features into Production environments using Jenkins, Spinnaker, GHA, Docker, Helm and Kubernetes into Amazon Web Services (AWS)
• Using agile methodologies such as Scrum, Kanban, Lean and SDLC

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical Lead, using Java, Spring, SpringBoot, Angular, Kafka, Kafka Streams, Flowable, Drools, MongoDB and MySQL for a distributed microservices architecture in the company Singular People LLC, working for a banking client.

• Design and take architectural decision
• Analysis and development of new features in the backend and frontend layer
• Deployment of new features into Production environments
• Using agile methodologies such as Scrum, Kanban, Lean and SDLC

positions.title: Junior Developer
positions.locationName: Las Rozas de Madrid y alrededores, España
positions.description:
Trabajo en el cliente de sector banca ING, en Las Rozas.
Análisis y resolución de incidencias que vienen de back, utilizando Profile (lenguaje MUMPS sobre AIX).
Análisis y resolución de incidencias que vienen de front, utilizando Java.
Amplio conocimiento funcional sobre como funciona el banco en el sector de compensación, medios de pago y cuentas.

positions.title: IT Support Staff en CSIRC.
positions.description: Mi trabajo consistía en administrar equipos de trabajo de profesores, solucionar problemas con la página web del CSIRC, administrar las videoconferencias realizadas entre profesores, solucionar problemas en la red wifi y resolver cuestiones sobre WordPress.
